title: Pauline Oliveros — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Pauline Oliveros's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.file: Pauline Oliveros — rich — one point, then the whole sphere.m4a
pieces.title: One point, then the whole sphere
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* A synthesized room, not a recording. Turning the other sounds down fifty times (34 dB) is the maker's stand-in for not attending; the page says sound 'arrives whether you attend to it or not', and here it nearly does not. The second half also carries a little reverb the first lacks. Nobody has listened. *Leaking in:* John Cage, whom her page's links say she contradicts: one sound in the room is a prepared string like the one in the sound on John Cage's page.

pieces.title: One point, then the whole sphere · drawn
pieces.caption: One room, heard twice. First attention closes on a single drip and the rain, the hum, the bird and the bell fall away. Then it opens and all of it is there at once.

verdicts.file: Pauline Oliveros — rich — one point, then the whole sphere.m4a
verdicts.why: Faithful to the page's focal and global, and the honest line owns the big choice. But "forty times" is fifty, in the honest line and in the picture's footer, and "a prepared string from his piece" reads as Cage's own piece when it is the maker's synthesized pluck from the sound on the Cage page.
